buying_advice.size_advice: Available sizes are S through 2XL. Reviews are generally positive about fit, but at least one customer reported a size issue. Shopi should recommend checking the size chart rather than guaranteeing fit.
buying_advice.fabric_advice: Use 'cotton-listed' or 'soft/smooth fabric' rather than claiming 100% cotton. The source has a direct Cotton-versus-Satin inconsistency.
buying_advice.quality_advice: Position it as a good-value shirt with generally positive quality feedback rather than as a premium luxury shirt.
buying_advice.value_advice: ₹395 is the strongest selling point. Multiple reviews explicitly describe the product as value for money.
buying_advice.occasion_advice: This is better suited to office, business-casual, daily and classic formal/semi-formal recommendations than SHIRT-012.
buying_advice.color_advice: Black and Grey are the safest versatile choices. Choco, Maroon and Wine work well for richer/evening styling. Sky Blue is better for lighter daytime styling. Olive should be recommended with a color-accuracy caveat.
